items.title: Threat Actors Leveraging Employee Monitoring and SimpleHelp Tools to Deploy Ransomware Attacks
items.description: Cybercriminals are increasingly using valid administrative software to launch attacks, making their malicious activities much harder to spot. Instead of relying solely on custom computer viruses, these actors abuse legitimate workforce monitoring tools to hide inside business networks. items.title: First Malicious Outlook Add-In Found Stealing 4,000+ Microsoft Credentials
items.description: Cybersecurity researchers have discovered what they said is the first known malicious Microsoft Outlook add-in detected in the wild.
